relevant_changes.app/app_root.gd: Telemetry context/paused reporting; first-Home construction unchanged.

historical_evidence.limitation: Summary-only cached-GPU freshness cannot be rechecked; not current Compatibility timing.
Different workload from Home; not a forecast for a product material.
Exploratory pass; first Home ineligible, actual drawable/internal pixels unverified.

findings.finding: The prior report ranked windsock scheduling, tree culling and particular shader expressions first without an affected-workload measurement. Source mechanisms establish possible cost, not its magnitude.
findings.disposition: Move R01/R03/R04/R06 behind the current pixel/material attribution. Keep them as conditional experiments, not committed speedups.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: The [retained comparison](2026-11-22-linux-uhd630-comparison.md) contains stronger screen-fill evidence: large ground-heavy Home ablations and scale sensitivity, but only 1.8–3.7 ms for a one-texture ground in the flight screen. Raw runs and GPU-poll freshness cannot be rechecked.
findings.disposition: Reuse the evidence as a lead, preserve its limits, and separate Home from flight. Never add overlapping ablation estimates or transfer an old Forward+ cost into current Compatibility.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: [Automatic policy](../../../app/render/auto_graphics_policy.gd), [display preferences](../../../app/app_state/display_preferences.gd) and [reconstruction](../../../app/render/reconstruction.gd) already implement scale choices and the recognized weak-GPU 75%/MSAA-off bundle.
findings.disposition: Start from GFX-IGPU-01. Do not list those delivered controls as missing work or count historical gains again.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: [Home budget](../../../app/render/home_render_budget.gd) is an existing independent temporary scale owner, with frame-count settling and two slow windows. Nominal 75% can become 52.5% at its floor.
findings.disposition: Record actual state/time-to-adjust; hold it constant for material A/B and verify production adaptation separately. No second scaler.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: The prior protocol's nine-case native graphical prerequisite conflicts with its own missing enrolled Linux adapter and Intel-utilization validator. No live route is configured in this workspace.
findings.disposition: Use the smallest actually admitted existing-Intel comparison when available. Source work continues; formal hardware/presentation qualification stays open rather than being bypassed.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: New automatic quality fields would exceed [calibration](../../../app/render/auto_calibration.gd)'s current identity/application scope. It samples root timing, can only shift scene level, and Low→lower clamps at Low. Unknown workload fields can match; root timing does not include every secondary pass.
findings.disposition: Manual controls first. Extend A5-R2/R3 identity, safe apply/retest and rollback before automatic promotion. A completed verdict is not proof a changed tier works.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: [Display ownership](../../../app/app_state/display_preferences.gd) infers managed values by type/value equality for strings as well as numbers. A user choosing the same value as Auto cannot record distinct manual intent under that heuristic.
findings.disposition: New controls and every deliberately set manual-bundle field need explicit intent before shipping. Include equal numeric/string selection, atomic ownership/value persistence, restore/cancel, restart and GPU change.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: Photo grass is enabled for the default field by [field setup](../../../app/render/field.gd) → [grass binder](../../../app/render/grass_ground_material.gd), independently of the enhanced research mode. The [fragment path](../../../app/render/ground.gdshader) still fades by distance/footprint.
findings.disposition: Reject both extremes: it is neither research-only nor six unconditional samples for every flight pixel. A simple whole material must be attributed before texture repacking.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: `scene_detail.gd`'s collision comment is stale. [Collision setup](../../../app/scenery/collision_setup.gd) passes full layout, [collision world](../../../app/scenery/collision_world.gd) builds its inventory and [scenery selection](../../../app/scenery/scenery.gd) retains collidable placements.
findings.disposition: Preserve/test the implemented physical contract. Do not create a needless collision-decoupling rewrite from the comment. RC track is a genuine scenario setting and stays outside graphics downgrade/reset.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: Existing Off choices have different lifetimes: built meadow is hidden; an aircraft projector can retain its target; ground cloud-shadow Off leaves legitimate sky cache consumers; lighting VFX still has update work.
findings.disposition: Define before-build, live-off, shared-owner, retention, reactivation and cancellation behavior per control. Do not assume Off means zero memory, or that retaining a bounded cache is necessarily a bug.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: Stock [lake water](../../../app/render/lake/water.gdshader) uses screen/depth refraction and a [probe](../../../app/render/lake/lake_terrain.gd). [Planar reflection](../../../app/render/lake/lake_planar_reflection.gd) is a High-only technical opt-in.
findings.disposition: Test Simple water and actual probe cost in lake-visible views; do not count disabling already-off planar reflection as a win or remove physical water.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: General smoke quality is not player-facing; [main](../../../app/main.gd) has a technical `--smoke=off` path that avoids visual nodes/subscriptions. `_supports_show_smoke()` also derives input availability from those nodes. Lens, birds, flags, overlays and lighting already have controls.
findings.disposition: Add smoke quality only for an attributed active workload. First separate retained equipment capability from render allocation so visual Off preserves AUX assignment, keyboard/radio/controller routing and fuel/sound semantics.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: The sixteen mechanisms mix first-use, steady rendering, optional features and small CPU work. A lower-fidelity material can improve runtime yet create more cold compilation; a cache can trade time for memory.
findings.disposition: Separate loading and flight acceptance, keep variant/caching budgets bounded and reject moving a stall to first visible use.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

findings.finding: “Works on low-end GPUs” had no distinct milestone, and the physics catch-up floor could be confused with a satisfactory experience.
findings.disposition: Propose per-run 30-FPS median, p95 ≤40 ms, p99 ≤50 ms, pace and readability targets for the owner to freeze. Reproduced >50-ms gameplay stalls still fail even when explained. Retain distinct existing 60-Hz/product/presentation gates; unavailable presentation evidence stays open.
findings.status: corrected in plan; runtime implementation not claimed

graphics_controls.current_main: Automatic/Standard/High; native 3D scale 100–50%; MSAA; frame cap; reconstruction provider.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: Reuse. Clearly distinguish saved scale, effective scale and provider-owned scale. Keep Compatibility for this Intel baseline.
graphics_controls.delivery: L1: visibility and matched use of existing controls; no new upscaler.

graphics_controls.current_main: Full procedural/photographic work is not selected by an independent player terrain-quality control. Default club photo maps are bound even without enhanced-grass research mode; execution still fades by distance/footprint.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: **Ground detail: Auto / Simple / Full.** Two bounded material variants; Simple preserves the flight surface cues and removes only attributed decorative work.

graphics_controls.current_main: Auto/Low/Medium/High/Extreme; Low uses tree cards and coarser LOD.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: Keep physical objects represented. First optimize batching internally; add a separate visual distance/LOD choice only if it changes a measured decision.
graphics_controls.delivery: L4, conditional. No blanket tree deletion.

graphics_controls.current_main: Meadow Off/On exists. Imported near grass has tier caps; technical grass modes are not a complete player density control.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: **Grass density: Auto / Off / Sparse / Standard** only for decorative, non-collidable vegetation. Meadow remains independently controllable. Do not reinterpret weather or surface friction.

graphics_controls.current_main: Technique, quality, distance, softness, aircraft cue and cloud shadows exist. Native atlas quality does not set aircraft mask 256²/4× MSAA or windsock 512²/MSAA-off.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: Extend the existing **shadow-quality** resolution to projected targets; investigate a separate aircraft override only if the shared setting cannot express a useful choice. Retain a cheap readable aircraft cue.
graphics_controls.delivery: L4: bounded resolution/AA experiment before defaults change.

graphics_controls.current_main: Stock lake uses a refresh-on-change probe. Planar is a High-only technical opt-in. Water shader samples screen/depth for refraction.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: **Water quality: Auto / Simple / Full.** Simple keeps the water/shoreline/wave representation, tests a material without refraction screen/depth inputs, and a cheaper reflection representation. Do not disable the lake scenario.
graphics_controls.delivery: L4 only for a costly lake-visible case.

graphics_controls.current_main: Ground cloud-shadow Off exists. Sky can still own shared cloud-cache tiles. Density-bound variants are research-only.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: **Cloud detail: Auto / Simple / Full** only after a supported, measured simple path exists. Preserve cloud coverage/weather cues, sun occlusion and clock. Keep cache mechanics internal.
graphics_controls.delivery: L4, conditional; not a promised default win.

graphics_controls.current_main: Lens Auto/Off/Low/Medium/High/Ultra and individual effects; lighting Low/Standard/High and show-VFX switch.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: Reuse. Audit inactive processing and release before adding another switch. Preserve essential navigation/landing cues.
graphics_controls.delivery: L4 internal fast paths if attributed.

graphics_controls.current_main: Pilot show-smoke input and technical `--smoke=off`; no general player smoke-quality selector.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: **Smoke: Auto / Off / Low / Full**, controlling visual particles/subscriptions only. Preserve pump inputs, engine/fuel state, sound and aircraft profile.
graphics_controls.delivery: L4 only with active smoke; not a baseline solo-flight claim.

graphics_controls.current_main: Birds Off/Few/Normal/Many, flags Auto/Static/Basic/Detailed, overlay presets and individual switches.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: Reuse. Low Auto flags resolve to Basic, not Static; windsock has a separate motion owner. Prioritize complete-workload cost before micro-optimizing these.
graphics_controls.delivery: Existing controls; internal work deferred by attribution.

graphics_controls.current_main: Options can change terrain, obstacles and scenario identity.
graphics_controls.planned_treatment: Keep under scenario selection. Exclude from graphics bundles/calibration, even if disabling them improves a diagnostic frame.

proposed_bundle.reconstruction: Explicitly switch to Native; list and reverse provider/settings change.

findings.challenge: A manual Very Low bundle can set the same numeric/string values as Auto and silently keep automatic ownership. Settings currently detects dirty state from values or calibration reset, so an ownership-only change may not enable Keep.
findings.resolution: §4.3/L2.4 treats ownership-only edits as dirty and atomically releases ownership of every deliberately set field, with restart/GPU-change and failure/Revert/Close/expiry tests. It does not wait for L5.
findings.status: resolved in plan

findings.challenge: A median-only target and “unexplained stalls” wording cannot decide whether low-end usability passed.
findings.resolution: §3 states provisional per-run tails, repeatable-stall rejection and cue review; the owner must freeze the checkpoint before acceptance. Physical presentation and 60-Hz release qualification remain separate.
findings.status: resolved in plan

findings.challenge: A mandatory Simple-ground delivery could survive negative current attribution; one failed candidate could end the whole investigation.
findings.resolution: L2.1 now stops that candidate and reranks if ground cost is inconclusive/negligible; L6.3 rejects individual candidates and preserves unmet release gates.
findings.status: resolved in plan

findings.challenge: An “accepted candidate” required the hardware test that was itself needed to accept it.
findings.resolution: L6.2 now starts with a software-ready provisional candidate. Offline work can proceed, but performance promotion and qualification require admitted evidence.
findings.status: resolved in plan

findings.challenge: Copying technical smoke Off would suppress equipment input availability.
findings.resolution: L4 requires capability state independent of visual nodes, with AUX, keyboard/radio/controller and reactivation checks before a smoke-quality option.
findings.status: resolved in plan

findings.challenge: Saving 75% while retaining a non-Native provider would not apply that scale.
findings.resolution: The explicit bundle selects Native and lists that touched choice; preview/Keep/Revert covers provider settings and actual effective scale.
findings.status: resolved in plan

calculations.interpretation: Arithmetic and source constants only; no predicted or measured speedup.

acceptance.optimization: At least 5% of declared affected complete workload beyond paired variation, or named reproducible hitch/memory defect; other relevant views avoid material regression.
acceptance.comparison: At least three alternating pairs, 10 s warmup and 60 s sample, or stricter applicable owner requirement.

low_end_checkpoint.status: proposed; owner must freeze workload and rule before acceptance
low_end_checkpoint.recurring_stall_rule: Repeated >50 ms gameplay stall in two of three candidate runs fails, even if explained.
low_end_checkpoint.cues: Moving aircraft, landing and night cues preserve matched-reference readability.

acceptance.unavailable_fields: Remain unavailable, never zero or a positive qualification.
acceptance.whole_tour: Conditional on complete three-aircraft scope; never blanket entry prerequisite.
